g.text: Temporary two-group persistence ends in all four selected worlds
Neutral founder labels: identical trait 250, mutation disabled. Gray region = original 3,000-tick observation.
All saved ticks plotted; left panels repeat early detail. Conditional follow-ups, not new independent seeds or a coexistence-rate estimate.
